ios.desc:
Evermusic – Cloud & Offline Music Player for iPhone and iPad.

Stream your entire music library from the cloud, listen offline, and take full control of your sound. Evermusic combines a powerful audio player, equalizer, playlist manager, and file organizer in one beautiful app.

• Play All Audio Formats
Evermusic supports the most popular audio formats: MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, AIFF, ALAC, M4B, and many others.

• Connect Your Cloud
Create your own music streaming service by moving your music library to the cloud. Listen to your music directly from the cloud, freeing up space on your iPhone for photos and new apps. Access music from most popular cloud services like iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, pCloud, and many others. Access privacy-focused cloud services like MEGA, Internxt, and Proton Drive as well.

• Connect Media Servers
Connect Plex, Subsonic, Navidrome, Jellyfin, and Emby media servers with your library easily.

• Connect Your Computer or NAS
Connect using SMB, WebDAV, DLNA, FTP, SFTP, and NFS protocols. Advanced buffering technologies ensure smooth playback. Connect to personal NAS storage using native APIs for QNAP, WD My Cloud Home, Nextcloud, and Synology Drive. Import audio files from your computer using iTunes File Sharing and Wi-Fi file transfer.

• Offline Music
Download your favorite songs, albums, and artists to listen offline. Enable the audio player cache to automatically download recently played songs.

• Audio Equalizer
The built-in equalizer offers presets for popular music genres, plus manual settings to customize your sound and amplify your music.

• Gapless Playback
Enjoy smooth playback with no pauses between songs, perfect for conceptual albums and classical music.

• Crossfade Playback
Enjoy continuous playback with the crossfade feature, where the next song starts before the current one ends.

• Audio Effects
Make your music sound the way you like with built-in audio effects. Turn on volume normalization to keep every track at the same loudness, and adjust playback with reverb, delay, distortion, and spatial audio.

• Music Visualizer
Watch full-screen animated visuals that react live to your music. Choose from a large library of presets, or let them cycle.

• Lyrics and Comments
View embedded timed lyrics and comments for your audio tracks. Activate the lyrics widget on the Home Screen for quick access.

• AirPlay & Chromecast
Stream music to Apple TV, smart speakers, or other devices with AirPlay or Chromecast.

quotes.text:
Hello, community!

We’re excited to announce a big update to Evermusic, your cloud and offline music player for iOS and macOS. 
Evermusic lets you build a music library from popular cloud services, network storage, and external drives, all while offering advanced playback features for an unparalleled listening experience.

Key Fixes and Updates

• Synology Drive Connection Fix: Resolved QuickConnect ID issues for Synology NAS users.
• Performance Optimization: You can now limit simultaneous Synology NAS connections to optimize server performance.
• Enhanced App Icons: Updated icons to support dark and tint modes for iOS dynamic icon options.
• Crossfade Issue Fix: Improved the crossfade feature to ensure smooth track transitions.
• Media Collection Archiving: Archive playlists, albums, and genres, with ZIP files including all tracks and an M3U file.
• Thumbnails for Online Files: Added thumbnail support for online files, with management in app settings.
• Updated File Icons: Modernized icons throughout the app for a consistent experience.
• CarPlay and DLNA Fixes: Resolved content loading issues on CarPlay and empty subfolder import issues on DLNA.

And there’s so much more! We also enhanced the app’s performance, added an analytics section in settings, and updated connection libraries for the latest security improvements.

quotes.text:
“Evermusic” is smart and powerful cloud music player. It has support for most popular cloud services including DropBox, Box, OneDrive, Google Drive. 
It has iPod style interface and a lot of useful features.

Download on the AppStore
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/evermusic/id885367198?ls=1&mt=8

With “Evermusic” you can:

- Listen to your music directly from the cloud.
- Download favorite songs on device for listening without internet connection. 
- Manage files between cloud storage: move, rename, delete, transfer. 
- Create playlists from music in cloud storage and download them for offline listening.
- Search songs, albums, artists in cloud library.
- View high quality album art loaded from internet.
- Listen to your music in background with remote controls support.

Website: http://leshkoapps.com/evermusic/

Download on the AppStore
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/evermusic/id885367198?ls=1&mt=8
